slides.heading: Min Max Stack Construction
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Stacks
slides.narration: Let's solve Min Max Stack Construction, a medium stacks problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: A stack with O(1) push, pop, peek, getMin and getMax by storing the running min/max alongside each element.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. A stack with constant push, pop, peek, getMin and getMax by storing the running min or max alongside each element.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Store the current min and max alongside each pushed value so they're always available.
slides.narration: Store the current min and max alongside each pushed value so they're always available.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Scan the stack for min/max → O(n)
Store (value, min, max) per entry → O(1) all ops
slides.narration: Scanning for min and max is linear per query. Storing the running min and max with each entry makes every operation constant time; popping automatically restores the old values.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. Push value with updated min and max
3. Peek, getMin and getMax read the top
slides.narration: Step by step. First, push value with updated min and max. Second, pop removes both. Third, peek, getMin and getMax read the top.

slides.heading: Worked example
slides.caption: push 5 → min 5, max 5
slides.narration: Push 5. Each entry stores the min and max of everything at or below it, so the top answers min 5 and max 5 instantly.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Each push stores the value with the min and max of itself and the previous top. Peek and pop read the value; get min and get max read the top's stored fields.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is constant per op. Space is O of n.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Popping needs no special handling, because the entry below already stores the correct min and max.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Store the current min and max alongside each pushed value so they're always available.
slides.narration: To recap Min Max Stack Construction: Store the current min and max alongside each pushed value so they're always available. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
